hooks.command:
bash -c '
  REPO=~/Desktop/CCode/ccos-make
  BACKUP=$REPO/_claude-backup

  # Copiar memórias de todos os projetos
  cp -r ~/.claude/projects/-Users-brunomartins-Desktop-CCode-ccos-make/memory/. $BACKUP/memory-ccos-make/ 2>/dev/null
  cp -r ~/.claude/projects/-Users-brunomartins-Desktop-CCode/memory/. $BACKUP/memory-ccode/ 2>/dev/null

  # Copiar settings globais
  cp ~/.claude/settings.json $BACKUP/settings/settings-global.json 2>/dev/null
  cp ~/.claude/settings.local.json $BACKUP/settings/settings-local.json 2>/dev/null

  # Auto-sync pro GitHub
  cd $REPO
  git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
  git remote get-url origin >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
  git add -A >/dev/null 2>&1
  git diff --staged --quiet && exit 0
  git commit -m "auto-sync: $(date +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")" >/dev/null 2>&1
  git push --quiet >/dev/null 2>&1
  true
'
